name: skylark_find_flight_date
intent: Find the date of a past SkyLark flight to a city
description: Searches the My Trips list in SkyLark Air for a trip to the requested city and returns the date of that flight.
patterns: what date was my trip to

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: The destination city of the trip to look up.

steps.intent: Scroll down until the trip to {{trip_city}} is visible
